thesis: AMPH is a profitable healthcare name in a clean uptrend (close 29.70 above SMA20 28.21, SMA50 26.63 and SMA200 22.38), with revenue growth accelerating to +8.2% YoY, net income of 37.8M against 17.4M a year earlier, and a forward P/E of 8.9. Healthcare (XLV) is one of only 5 sectors above its 50-day in a tech-led risk-off tape. From the 29.15 zone midpoint, the 27.60 stop and 32.16 target give R/R 1.94. However, the trade needs a breakout through the 31.00 high that was rejected on 11/6, so this is a small, fill-conditional Overweight and should not be chased at 29.70, where R/R is only about 1.17.
invalidation: Daily close below 27.60, or a rejection at 31.00 followed by a close back under 28.80 on rising volume.
key_risks: Risk-off regime (VIX 29.99, 1-year percentile 0.981; QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages) can drag down even names that are holding up
R/R to the 31.00 high alone is about 1.2, and that high was rejected intraday on 11/6, so the target depends on a breakout
Sell-side consensus is 'Reduce' with a mean target of 24.5, about 21% below the 29.70 close, so a downgrade or target cut is possible
Leverage is meaningful (total debt 691.7M, debt/equity 84.9) and free cash flow is thin (9.2M)
21.7% short float means sharp moves in either direction; the +5.1% move on 11/23 has no news driver and came on average volume (ratio 1.02)
CFO sold 11,000 shares at 29.99 under a 10b5-1 plan on 11/18
Correlated healthcare exposure (lesson 8): cap combined healthcare weight rather than sizing AMPH on its own
Next earnings date is not in the packet (last report 2026-11-05)
